records.text: No major U.S. media outlet reported the Israeli cybersecurity official's arrest, and an acting district attorney who was an Israeli national let him go.
records.speaker: Bassem Youssef

appearances.snippet: This happened in the United States. You know what's the most important thing about this is that not a single media outlet reported that this ever happened. ... ABC, ... Fox News, CNBC, ... CNN, ... nothing. ... And then you have like the acting D.A. who happened to be an Israeli national who ... let him go.

verification.notes: Major U.S. media, including Axios, reported the case. DOJ states release followed Clark County’s standard bail schedule; the acting U.S. attorney did not personally free Alexandrovich, and the relevant local district attorney was Steve Wolfson.

sources.relevance: Directly contradicts the claim that major U.S. media did not report the case.

sources.title: Acting United States Attorney Sigal Chattah Statement
sources.relevance: Explains that release was under the county’s standard bail schedule and distinguishes federal and local responsibility.

records.text: Sarah Tewell said the shot entered Charlie Kirk's left side from her right and estimated the shooter was about 200 yards away.
records.speaker: Sarah Tewell

appearances.snippet: Yes, correct. Yeah, it went right into his left side and the shooter was from my right and even in the middle it was still to the right. And I'm pretty sure you had somebody say this earlier, but I think it was about 200 yards away.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Archived interview footage records Tewell saying the shot entered on the left side, came from her right, and was roughly 200 yards away. This verifies her attributed account, not the objective trajectory or distance.

sources.title: The Witness Lineup - Chest on FOX 13, Neck on KSL

sources.title: Witnesses to fatal Charlie Kirk shooting recount gruesome scene
